notes.title: Occupy Mars Today!
notes.content:
[h2]Martians! The day has come![/h2]

[b]Occupy Mars: The Game is now available for all of you to play in Early Access! See the Launch Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=0BgyGklgsas;full][/previewyoutube]
It's truly indescribable how amazing it feels to finally reach this day of launch after years of hard work! This incredible journey began more than 10 years ago when we conceived the idea for this game during our time at university. 

The development of the game itself started in 2017, and now we have reached the significant milestone of Early Access Launch. Our dream game has reached a point where we are thrilled to share it with you! 

This is just the beginning of a much longer journey, as we have an [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars]ambitious roadmap[/url] ahead of us.

[h3]But for now, let's focus on playing![/h3]
For those diving right into the game - please keep in mind that the following [b]known issues in the current build v0.119.1:[/b] 
 - loading abandoned bases - procedural outposts can sometimes relocate after loading the game
 - saving the game when rover is on crusher can in some cases block rover
 - ATV sometimes doesn't spawn next to the abandoned base but further away
 - tornado/dust devils can pull the player from abandoned base and throw away with high speed
 - repairing boards one after another can block workbench
 - soldering tool and hotair tool can disappear from workbench
 - player can die when building rover and standing too close to the ghost
 - cables can hang in the air and block interactions
 - tutorial 6 can be blocked if player replants tree seedlings to crate before receiving instruction to do so
 - there may be gaps in the terrain at the borders of the map squares
 - There may be FPS drops while riding ATV/ROVER
 - loot may spawn under the terrain or inside walls/floors
 - player can be able to equip 2 tools at once and block interactions
 - weather effects may last after the icon on hud disappears
 - ATV crates content is not saved
 - saving game manually when there is space sign at the end of save's name blocks saving the game
 - after longer gameplay random textures may be spawn on random models or not spawn at all 

[b]Minor or less frequent issues and edge cases:[/b]
 - the surface of frozen lake can spawn over the ground
 - there are several rare issues which can randomly block saving the game
 - ghost of rover can be built only in specific places
 - saving the game after placing ghost of workbench but before building it may be impossible
 - leaving the base while printer works freezes printer indefinitely.
 - aiming while using jackhammer&grinder can be sometimes difficult
 - upgrading jackhammer to level 3 without unlocked technology is possible but can break the game
 - player can duplicate boards on workbench but doing so can block facility.
 - boards may have full HP while having broken parts on workbench
 - saving and loading the game after upgrading tool but before taking it from workbench duplicates the tool but can break the game
 - FPP camera while driving on ATV can go inside players head on some angles
 - charging suit from battery/transformer may sometimes not work
 - tipper dislodged from trailer by meteor can be impossible to reattach
 - after loading save from campaign, there are pipes and cables in ambulatory 
 - some sounds may not be properly adjusted

We are focusing on solving all of those issues as well as adding more content.
We are planning regular updates. Next one will be live tomorrow, and the next the day after tomorrow... ːsteamhappyː

Remember that you can press F4 during the game to post Feedback directly to us. 

[b]See you on Mars![/b]

notes.title: DevLog #59: Content at Launch
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

[b]We’re getting ready for May 10th and we’d like to share a few more details with you.[/b]

[b]All our Kickstarter Backers who supported the project and who had Early Access key listed as one of the rewards for their pledge will be happy to know that we’re currently sending out keys! Please check your e-mail inboxes! Keep in mind that even though you receive them a little ahead of release time, keys will become active at the moment of Early Access release on May 10th. 

You can follow the countdown clock on our official website: [url=https://occupymarsgame.com]occupymarsgame.com[/url][/b]

We’d like to thank our 12,000 Beta testers for their contribution to the Beta Playtest phase. Thanks to you, we’ve received plenty of invaluable feedback and managed to greatly improve overall game experience. Beta Playtest version will be available until May 8th so this is the [b]last weekend to play it[/b]. 
On Monday this particular version will be disabled in preparation for Early Access launch.

We have also determined a [b]final list of features which will be available on Early Access release[/b], and other functionalities which will be subsequently enabled in the next updates according to our [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars][b]updated roadmap[/b][/url].

[h2]The features which will be available on launch day include:[/h2]

[h3]Language versions available on launch: 10[/h3]

[b]English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, Portugese, Chinese.[/b]
[i](we are also working on Ukrainian, Romanian, Dutch, Japanese and Korean but those are not ready and will be added in an update later)[/i]

[h3]Game modes available on launch: 3[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Campaign [/b]Mode (introduction to the story with NPCs and cinematics!)
[*] [b]FreePlay [/b]Sandbox Mode (procedurally generated gameplay where you can select difficulty level, starting location, starting equipment, intensity of weather conditions and other parameters)
[*] [b]Tutorial Mode[/b]: E.R.A. Virtual Training: 6 Tutorial scenes
[*] and of course [b]detailed character creator[/b]!
[/list][i](the continuation of the Campaign mode, more tutorial scenes, as well as an Online Co-Op mode will come to the game later in the form of updates)[/i]

[h3]Technology Trees available on launch: 4[/h3]
[b]Botany, Electricity, Materials, Mechanics[/b]
[i](the Chemistry tech tree will be added later as an update, also some technologies in each tech tree are locked and will be added after early access launch)[/i]

[h3]Vehicles available to build in the game at early access launch:[/h3]
[b]ATV Quad (with upgrades), Ingenuity Helicopter, Jetpack and Heavy Rover with 2 types of trailers[/b].
[i](Motocross and Truck still require some driving adjustments so they will be enabled later)[/i]

[h3]Available tools:[/h3]
[b]Air Compressor, Blowtorch, Grinder, Jackhammer, Seed Tool, Spectral Detector, Cordless Drill, Detonator, Fire extinguisher, Remote controller, pipes, cables and various building materials.[/b]

[h3]Plants available to cultivate:[/h3]
[b]Apple, Oxygen Tree, Poplar, Spruce, Pepper, Corn, Tomato, Potato, Lettuce, Cabbage, Pumpkin.[/b]

[h3]Weather events:[/h3]
[b]Sandstorms, Dust devils, Tornado, Solar storm, Meteor shower, Lightning Strike, Cold nights.[/b]

[h3]Tablet Functions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Messages[/b] - new version of the quest log 
[*] [b]Inventory[/b] - completely new inventory view
[*] [b]Blueprints[/b] - list of constructions to build
[*] [b]Tech Trees[/b] - technology browser and unlocking section
[*] [b]Knowledge Base[/b] - a goldmine of knowledge about Mars
[*] [b]Radar[/b] - useful for mapping surroundings and remotely controlling devices
[/list]additional tablet views include:[list]
[*] [b]Alarm clock view[/b] - shown after clicking on a bed
[*] [b]Bluetooth Radio control[/b] - shown after clicking on a Radio (allows to play your own music)
[*] [b]Robots[/b] view - currently disabled as player can't yet own robots 
[/list]
[h3]Buildings available to build at early access launch:[/h3]
Airlock, ramp, 2x leveling corridor joints, small solar panel, medium solar panel, transformer, transformer upgrade, battery, battery upgrade, lamp, 3x antennas, well, co2 scrubber, sabatier reactor, vertical tanks, horizontal tanks, pump, small rock crusher, big rock crusher / printer, greenhouse with hydroponics shelf, plant incubator, seed machine, composter, small dome, medium dome, large dome, workshop, living capsule, survival capsule, bathroom, various capsule adapters, lobby, cantina, main hab (HQ) with equipment, food processing unit, small 3d printer, bed, fridge, workbench, 4x science bench types for different technologies, the garage (hangar), anti-meteor launcher, 9 types of corridors (long, short, with or without windows, 90 deg angle and crossroads).

[i](more objects, buildings and vehicles will be enabled in subsequent updates)[/i]

[b]Certain technologies in the game will be marked as “Beta” on launch[/b] – these features are a work in progress and as such, they will still be updated and changed. Some functionalities are disabled and as a result, [b]certain achievements will be disabled at launch[/b] – the ones which will be disabled are listed below:
[list]
[*] Life on Mars
[*] Good Martian
[*] You've got a friend in me
[*] Rocket Scientist
[*] The cake is a lie
[*] Let's Cook
[/list] [i]those will start working after more technologies will be unlocked in content updates.[/i]

We’d like to let you know right away that [b]you’re welcome to report any issues[/b] you encounter in Early Access. For this purpose, in-game reporting feature (triggered by [b]F4[/b] key) has been fixed and added to the Early Access version.

[b]P.S. What’s the first thing you’ll do after arriving on Mars?[/b] 
Watch the E.R.A. Corporate news below for some ideas 🚀
[previewyoutube=qc6XOF1tQxM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]We are excited to see you on Mars!
Occupy Mars Team[/h3]

[b]P.S.2. May The 4th Be with you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/7b84edb85698302d742820cc84bfc0f2b7f0e6d4.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #56: Kickstarter Summary, Early Access Progress & Tight Beam from Mars
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1]

Welcome to another DevLog - this time we have plenty of topics to discuss.

[h2]1. Kickstarter Summary[/h2]

As you might know, our [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/]Kickstarter Campaign[/url][/b] ended on February 17th after 31 days and [b]it was a great success![/b] [b]Over 2662 Martians[/b] backed our project and we crossed the magical [b]400% Funded[/b] mark.

In total [b]13 Stretch Goals[/b] were unlocked with the last one: [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733716]Automated Excavation[/url][/b] being unlocked during the last few hours of the campaign!🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/e4e5c8b1b1123130dd91d70967be4aeecc10a872.png[/img]

In the last few Kickstarter Updates you can read about:
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3731194]The final list of all unlocked stretch goals[/url][/b] 
(which will also serve as [b]our roadmap for post-release development)[/b]
[*] [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733716]Automated Excavation plan[/url][/b]
[*] [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733714]Kickstarter Reward Highlights[/url][/b]
[*] [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts]and more...[/url]
[/list]
[h2]2. Kickstarter Rewards[/h2]

Now that Kickstarter had ended, we're [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/occupy-mars-the-game/posts/3733714]preparing to send rewards[/url][/b] to our amazing backers. 
According to plan: [b]most of the digital rewards should be sent in March, and the Physical Collector's Edition Boxes should be ready to send in May[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/371496f00c500d5fa88588bc06188696ed1f565f.png[/img]

[h2]3. Early Access Build Progress[/h2]

We are [b]working hard on the final Early Access Build[/b]. There's still a few things to do in order to give you the news you're all waiting for – about Early Access release date. 

[h3]Currently [b]our internal goal is to release Early Access by the end of March or April[/b]. The final date depends on final testing and balancing the game. [b]We'll make the announcement as soon as we're ready.[/b][/h3]

[h2]4. Freeplay Rebalance & Vehicle Building[/h2]

In the last devlog we've shown the progress with [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3633877993333406386]New Inventory, Tutorials and Interior Lighting[/url][/b]. 

Today we want to show you the progress regarding [b]Freeplay rebalance and Vehicle Spawning, as well as progress with the Tech Tree.[/b]

[b]The Tech Tree[/b] in the game has been expanded. With many more technologies and blueprints to unlock. Those changes are connected with the game rebalance and with the way vehicles are spawned.

At the beginning of the Freeplay (Sandbox) mode player will start without vehicles. At first our Martian will have to survive based on the resources available in the landing capsule. First few nights will require sleeping in the capsule as well. But soon after, by unlocking new technologies and blueprints, he will be able to travel further and further away from the starting location, mine more resources, build buildings, new equipment and eventually also [b]build vehicles[/b]. 

We believe this rework will give a much greater sense of progression and satisfaction from gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/3d1f7c3492995d8812db2457f41a6db01240c676.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/ac79c3dac6c8a438442a41bddf91f387ed87b234.png[/img]

[h2]5. Tight Beam From Mars: Episode 9 - Growing Plants[/h2]

For those who might have missed it - we have released another Episode of [b]Tight Beam from Mars[/b]. In [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-j-xu5ehMwI]Episode #9[/url][/b] we are focusing on [b]Plant Cultivation[/b] where we explain the details about how it works in our game vs real simulated Mars bases. Watch the new [b]Episode 9[/b] below:

[previewyoutube=-j-xu5ehMwI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven't seen the previous episodes yet, [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQOps1WWd4PYMXAgMfK8ZnsycFEyanLXv]here's the full playlist[/url][/b].

In the next Episode #10 we will talk about [b]Energy Production and Survival Events[/b].

[h2]6. Occupy Mars: Colony Builder - Mobile tests started[/h2]

We have [b]started the tests of our mobile game[/b] [b][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pyramidgames.occupymarscolonybuilder]Occupy Mars: Colony Builder[/url][/b]. 

[b]Over 300 backers[/b] are already playing the [b]Android & iOS Beta version[/b], reporting bugs and helping us balance it before the release. We have also released a [b]new teaser trailer of Occupy Mars: Colony Builder[/b] - you can watch it below:

[previewyoutube=a572vUepJYA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]7. Thank you![/h2]

Once again, [b]we'd like to thank each and every one of you[/b] – our backers and everyone here on Steam who believes in us. It's thanks to you that this project has come this far and we have no words to describe how thankful we are for your support throughout all these years.

We're working hard to bring you a truly memorable experience.

Yours Truly Grateful,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: DevLog #53: Beta status & 10th Kickstarter goal unlocked
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Martians![/h2]

[h3]Beta Status Update[/h3]

As the recent build [b]v0.99.9.3[/b] was met with positive reception and our playtesters have noted a vast improvement over the previous build, we’re moving this build from the public_testing branch to the default branch on Steam.

[h3]To whoever has yet to update the Beta to the latest version, we recommend starting a new game as saves from the previous versions might not work properly after the update.[/h3]

We thank all of you who participated in Beta for all the feedback and bug reports we have received from you so far. [b]Occupy Mars: The Game[/b] has come a long way since we first started Beta and it’s all thanks to you. We now have a much better understanding regarding what requires our attention. That’s why we’d like to let you know that [b]this update is the final update for Beta[/b]. Any more days spent on improving the Beta would delay the long awaited Early Access. That’s why we think it’s about time to move on to the next stage. From here onwards, we’re focusing solely on preparing a final Early Access build.

[b]Known Issues in Beta  v0.99.9.3:[/b] 
[list]
[*] rover door can be opened partially and blocked in that position if player instantly after clicking on the door uses hotbar to pull out any tool. That can be reversed by doing the same thing,
[*] when player puts partially crushed rock in the tipper, sometimes it doesn’t crumble. In that case try to grab it and put it again in different spot in tipper,
[*] sometimes player can see "holes" in the map in places when two parts of the map are connected. Saving and reloading fixes problem,
[*] some weather effects can affect the player even if he is inside a base,
[*] abandoned bases may disappear and appear after loading the game,
[*] there might still be problems with rover extensions and/or skill points in tech tree,
[*] in some PC configurations players can experience significant drop of FPS in FPP mode,
[*] inability to skip sleeping in some rare cases,
[*] seed machine can sometimes duplicate seed tanks,
[*] some parts of abandoned bases don't disappear when the base is scrapped.
[/list]
[b]Important notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] there are several smaller but non game breaking bugs in the tutorials, there will be different tutorials in the full Early Access build so please don't report bugs regarding those,
[*] there are several non critical bugs that do not break the game but may cause inconvenience for the players, both of those categories will be fixed for EA,
[*] if you are playing on save from previous version building connectors will need to be removed and replaced due to the fix to stop you going outside through them,
[*] as we introduce new tutorials and campaign mode we have to shift focus from the beta version to prepare the build for Early Access.
[/list]

[h3]Kickstarter Progress[/h3]

[b]We did it![/b] We just crossed the 80 000 CA$ stretch goal, which means that “[b]Dexter[/b]'' goal has been unlocked! A crafting mechanic will be added to the game, which will allow you to [b]create chemical compounds[/b]!

It’s the [b]10th goal[/b] of this campaign and we’re only now halfway into the campaign. In 2 weeks, we’re already [b]265% funded[/b] and we have [b]17 days left[/b]! 

Just look how far we’ve come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/223b08d6b13beb4c5525af74ed8c6cd8e89ee677.png[/img]

Next stop – “Liftoff!”, which will unlock once we gather another 10 000 CA$. Can we do it?

Big thank you to over [b]1 680 Martians[/b] who have supported the project so far! There are still plenty of goals waiting for us, so let’s keep going!

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #50: Beta Update & Kickstarter Status
notes.content:
Here is the previous devlog that has been published last month on Occupy Mars: The Game page:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/758690/view/3480747995742366774
It includes the [b]roadmap[/b], [b]Kickstarter announcement[/b] and answers many of the questions we received from our community.


[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

Welcome to our [b]50th Monthly Devlog[/b]! We have just released the long-awaited [b]Beta Update v0.99.2[/b] which includes big changes such as: 

[h3]New Interaction System[/h3]

An important [b]rework of the interaction system[/b] has been completed and playtesters can now check it out. It was [url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars][b]a very important milestone on our roadmap to Early Access[/b][/url], which should address one of the most frequently reported issues - to make the controls more responsive and more user friendly. 

[url=https://roadmap.occupymarsgame.com/#/occupymars][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/80f79ba0dc63fa1473308621fab36ea6088ba272.png[/img][/url]

The most important thing you should know about the [b]New Interaction System[/b] is that now: 

* [b]pressing 1x LMB[/b] = picks up an item to your hand, and then: 
--- [b]the second time you press LMB[/b] = it will collect the item from your hand into your inventory 
--- [b]if you are holding any tool[/b] then of course the [b]LMB[/b] will intuitively use that tool
--- [b]press 2x LMB quickly[/b] (or hold [b]CTRL+LMB[/b]) to take the item from the ground directly to your inventory (no more hold and wait!)

* [b]pressing 1x RMB[/b] = stop using tool or drop other item from your hand on the ground
--- [b]you also need to press RMB[/b] to cancel any action such as sitting in the Vehicle or Workbench
--- keep in mind that the [b]ESC[/b] button will no longer work to cancel actions because we've introduced...

[h3]New Pause Menu[/h3]

After carefully analyzing your requests and after many discussions we decided to add the new [b]ESC Menu[/b].
- All the game settings, saves and control settings were moved from the Tablet to the new Pause Menu
- You can now press ESC at any time during the gameplay (except a few places) to open the Pause Menu which is separate from the Tablet functionality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/920f9d5f1ca2f19cddc27bf959ec40b9980fb69f.png[/img]

[h3]New Main Menu Experience[/h3]

Today we also have [b]something special[/b] for you: the new main menu you know from our last weekly streams has been merged with the Beta branch so now you can admire it in its full glory. We've also uploaded a music video from it - a [b]4K artistic experience[/b] - you can watch it now on our YouTube channel:

[previewyoutube=uOsiigPeF1I;full][/previewyoutube]
If you love it like we do, you can listen it on repeat here ➡️ https://pls.watch/#v=uOsiigPeF1I 😉

[h3]Beta Update Changelog[/h3]
v0.93.3 -> v0.99.2

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Interaction System
[*] New Pause Menu
[*] New Main Menu Experience
[*] Added small 3D Printer in Landing Capsule
[*] Added small CO2 Scrubber in Landing Capsule
[*] Added text captions to voice notification system
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Pump UI values going out of frame
[*] Fixed infinite lightning storm sometimes happening
[*] Fixed starting capsule light, power and oxygen
[*] Fixed battery building collider limitations
[*] Fixed the wind power of dust devils
[*] Fixed water tank changing color after detonation
[*] Fixed resetting vehicles in hangar
[*] Fixed hand-holding position of multiple objects
[*] Fixed 3D printing UI and dropdowns
[*] Fixed vehicles getting explosion damage
[*] Fixed Rover driving slower when full
[*] Fixed overwriting autosave/quicksave 
[*] Fixed ores spawning in caves of Olympus Mons
[*] Fixed sleeping in landing capsule chairs
[*] Fixed meteor shower giving mechanics experience
[*] Fixed Air compressor Tool
[*] Fixed radiation Geiger sounds
[*] Fixed rocks loading on trailer during world shifting
[*] Fixed some player animations (jumping, crouching, interactions)
[*] Fixed postprocessing on screenshots of saved games
[*] Fixed saving loot items from destroyed bases
[*] Fixed saving player inside caves
[*] Fixed holding more than one item in hand
[*] Fixed dirt on Rover after sandstorm
[*] Fixed Rover trailer self detach
[*] Fixed damaging crusher after parking Rover on it
[*] Fixed Rover welder with/without container
[*] Fixed mouse acceleration setting save
[*] Fixed lightsource in HQ and other buildings
[*] Fixed saving game during repairing pcb board
[*] Fixed Well UI screen interaction
[*] Fixed battery capacity calculation after destroying battery upgrades
[*] Improved Heavy Rover wheels
[*] Improved DragBuilder interactions
[*] Improved interior lights in buildings
[*] Improved buildings Lobby, Cantina and others
[*] Improved graphics option (added TerrainPixelError)
[*] Improved player hands animations
[*] Improved text massage panel on the right
[*] Improved quality on lower graphics settings
[*] Improved small pickable rocks, more pickup types
[*] Optimization of GPU materials instancing on dynamic objects
[*] Balance Fix - Dust on solar panels disappeared too quickly
[*] Multiple translations improvements
[*] ...and more
[/list]
[b]Known Issues in this version:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Composter is not working[/b] in this build.
[*] Once you dump rocks from the trailer into the crusher you need to save & load, otherwise you [b]won't be able to load the trailer with rocks[/b] again.
[*] The New Interaction System should also work with [b]gamepad controllers[/b] however we didn't have time to properly test it yet, let us know if there are any problems.

[*] [quote][b]Warning! Do not play with headphones[/b] as there are a few sounds which are too loud playing during the loading of the game as well as during the game when new terrain chunks with abandoned bases are generated.[/quote]
[*] [quote][b]Warning![/b] Before playing please [b]reset your controls settings to default[/b] in main menu after updating to this version, otherwise new interactions may cause strange issues.[/quote]
[/list]The above mentioned known issues will hopefully be fixed in the next 0.99.x build. Please let us know if you find any more issues.

[h3]100th Development Sprint![/h3]

Our plan currently is that [b]builds up to version v0.99.x will be the last builds for the beta[/b], and [b]builds v0.100+ will go only to the main game Early Access branch[/b] so that we can focus on the main game release and make sure everything is polished there.

[b]Build v0.100 is a great milestone[/b] - it means that [b]we have completed over 100 2-week sprints[/b] while working on the game since the beginning. Looking back at those 5 years, it’s hard to imagine the amount of work we’ve put into it, we hope you will enjoy it. For the next build, we'll be focusing on the most important [b]Tech Tree[/b] and Balance changes necessary before Early Access Release.

[h3]Kickstarter Status[/h3]

As we promised in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3480747995742366775][b]Previous Update[/b][/url], we’d like to let you know about the status of the upcoming Kickstarter campaign as soon as anything clarifies. 

Just before Christmas we've learned that another Kickstarter campaign for a different game was started on the same partner account so we need to wait until it ends. We were surprised by this but, after talking to advisors experienced with Kickstarters they said it's a good thing because campaigns during Winter Holidays historically aren't as successful and that January is better time. So after talking it over, we’ve accepted this fact since this is better for the game as well.

So we can finally confirm that [b]our Kickstarter campaign will launch on January 17th[/b]. That also means that [b]Early Access release will come later than January 2023 (after the Kickstarter finishes)[/b]. As for our talks with potential international publishers (mentioned in the last devlog) they are still ongoing so we'll keep you posted once we have some more information about it.

We’ve also made a small update to [url=www.occupymarsgame.com][b]the game’s official page[/b][/url] - added a countdown for Kickstarter Launch:

[url=www.occupymarsgame.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/53080bb0e8bb884753d94745623555bc6e6c7189.png[/img][/url]

[h3]More beta invites[/h3]

Each new Beta build comes with new Beta invitations, so we're giving access to the Beta to more players. As we feel this update is particularly important, we’re now granting access to the Beta to additional [b]7 000[/b] randomly chosen players from those registered in the Steam Playtest system. With this, 10 000 players should now have access to the Beta version! That's a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/f0b62f41973056e732597d16eb7d1e20627b90ed.png[/img]

To all of you who find Occupy Mars: The Game Playtest version in their Steam library – we hope you'll enjoy the game and [b]please remember to give us your feedback[/b]!

[h3]Sharing your feedback[/h3]

A separate Sub-Forum on Steam called Beta Discussions was created for those who have access: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1802390/discussions/0/][b]LINK[/b][/url]

Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #48: Progress & Mars Society Convention
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

It’s time for us to report on our development progress since our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3258938103877676844][b]last devlog[/b][/url]. 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3258938103877676844

If you’re watching our streams on [url=https://twitch.tv/pyramid_games][b]Twitch[/b][/url], you might be familiar with some of these features. Nevertheless, we hope this devlog will give a better picture of the game’s current state.

[h3]FOUNDATIONS[/h3]

We have implemented [b]foundations[/b] into the building system. They come in various shapes. In the future, the system will be improved to allow building on those foundations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/d5bb2b5c12491d07d075b7c3e6061c062d119792.gif[/img]

[h3]UI CHANGES[/h3]

[b]Pop-up notifications[/b] have been added to many options in Main Menu and in tablet UI, with one of the most important ones being an additional window “Do you want to leave the game?” requiring final confirmation from the player. Moreover, with new features and new panels added to tablet UI, [b]interface’s overall design has been polished[/b] to make sure it’s consistent across all panels. Main Menu has been rearranged and modified according to players and our testing team’s feedback to make it easier to navigate and more legible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/eab33b17ff9dd5ad17654b9292945a2dafa5f927.gif[/img]

[h3]INFOPANELS[/h3]

Information about missions and tutorials has been [b]moved to the Tips panel[/b] for easier access. Tips panel will now feature tips along with your current tasks.

[h3]DETAILS[/h3]

[b]Arrows[/b] have been added to ghosts of various objects in building mode to indicate where the plug is and to help players place those objects with that in mind.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eaoVhEG.gif[/img]

Tools upgrading system and plant models have been improved. We also continue polishing [b]astronaut’s animations[/b]. A [b]sorting mechanic[/b] has been added to better organize the contents of your inventory.


[h3]TECH BOARDS[/h3]

Special [b]Tech Boards[/b] have been included in the game. They are spread all around Mars and [b]give a boost to your Tech Tree abilities[/b]. Highlighting mechanic has been added to make it easier to locate them when you get close enough. After finding Tech Board and interacting with it, its data is [b]automatically downloaded to Tablet[/b], where you can find information about Tech Tree points you’re earned.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SqDL4uw.gif[/img]

[h3]CABINETS[/h3]

It’s now possible to build a [b]cabinet[/b] inside the buildings. Various items can be safely put there. This cabinet’s purpose is to give you some place for storing your items. While it will definitely help with keeping your base tidy, you have to remember that it won’t prevent your food from spoiling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/0ced8663c7e847c2169b014b717c1ea009cdd476.gif[/img]

[h3]GREENHOUSE UPGRADES[/h3]

[b]Greenhouse Tutorial[/b] has made it back to the game and domes now come with soil management mechanic. It’s possible to build a [b]composter[/b] which will allow you to make use of any leftover materials to improve the quality of your crops. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/940ab2c57bd12e7053d9282f3dd3a95c88fd662b.gif[/img]

[h3]ALERTS[/h3]

[b]New music track[/b] has been added to let you know when your buildings have been damaged and require immediate attention. What’s more, [b]flickering red lights[/b] inside the damaged buildings will alert you about the danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/0e344b177a76d63d9106b6878f23aa367423a7f0.gif[/img]

We are now working on [b]improving tutorials[/b]. Electricity system tutorial in particular will require an overhaul to introduce players to functionality of circuit breakers.

[h3]ROCKET LAUNCHER[/h3]

Lastly, we have added the long awaited [b]anti-meteor rocket launcher[/b]! If you’re fed up with sleeping through meteor storms and you don’t like the idea of fixing your base afterwards, this rocket launcher allows you to shoot down threatening meteors before they hit your home.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U8GDsVH.gif[/img]

[h3]MARS SOCIETY CONVENTION[/h3]

That would be all we have to show you for today. However, we are preparing a few big announcements for you. In just a few more hours, on [b]October 20th at 2 PM PST[/b] our CEO will participate in the Mars Society Convention with a presentation about Occupy Mars development. Check out the [url=https://www.marssociety.org][b]event’s website[/b][/url] if you’re looking forward to Occupy Mars: The Game, keep your eyes on our social media profiles and News tab here on Steam!

https://www.marssociety.org

[url=https://www.marssociety.org][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/79adef388ad2d87275fe5a4e4acec4c81ee77a2d.png[/img][/url]

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #46: Survival Fest & Development Progress
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Martians![/h1]

Today is the last day of the [b]Survival Festival[/b]. Now that more players have tried out Occupy Mars: Beta and Prologue, let’s talk about development progress of the upcoming Early Access release! We’d like to show you a few things we’ve been working on.

[h2]Updated UI[/h2]
We mentioned a few times in the past that we were reworking the UI, adding new interfaces for many new features that weren’t in the game before and polishing the existing ones. In the previous devlog and during our streams, you could see the new Sleeping panel. This time, we’d like to show you:

[h3]New Messages Panel[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uMdLOto.gif[/img]

[h3]New Inventory[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/50cd81c60f3f51dfdc316ecff5709694c4e95cee.png[/img]

And last but not least, menu of one of the more complex features in the game…
[h3]Tech Tree – work in progress[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/o4GnPD6.gif[/img]

[h2]More options and customization[/h2]
Now, you have even more options to adjust the game to your needs! To be more specific, there are many [b]more options visible in the Graphics section[/b] right off the bat. Some of those could be accessed in the main Quality tab, but now they are split into more visible individual settings. 

Here is what you’ll be able to set:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/77a13421e8ca19d38496767f3ed57a6b9019761f.png[/img]

Let us tell you about the "[b]Always render environment[/b]" option. Terrain rendering allows you to decide whether you’d like to have the terrain visible from inside your buildings or not. It mostly affects the buildings with windows – if the option is checked, you will see the view outside your window. If the option is not checked, scenery outside will be replaced with simulation – not necessarily accurate to your surroundings, but believable enough to not bother you much.

It’s a very useful feature optimization-wise as it allows you to reduce GPU’s usage and make the game run smoothly if you experience lag in the game. Losing that nice view from your window is a minor loss in comparison. :)

There were also some issues related to saving on specific devices – we have changed the way the game is saved and hopefully, that will solve those issues.

Time (and testing) will tell!

[h2]Mechanic improvements[/h2]
We continuously improve existing game mechanics. The controls of [b]Seed Tool[/b] and the[b] Air Pressure Tool[/b] have been slightly changed. After taking out the tool, you can now press Up and Down arrow keys to choose the magazine you want. Menu to the right gives you an overview of seeds you have.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C9mC4HV.gif[/img]

We’ve been further improving mechanic of [b]drilling and rock mining[/b]. [b]Rock analysis[/b] with the upgraded Spectral Detector on 2nd and 3rd level has also been vastly improved.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M2cv7RV.gif[/img]

We have also made changes to temperatures and [b]adjusted damage player receives due to low temperature[/b]. In the past, player was receiving set amount of damage throughout time frame of 5 PM and 6 AM. Now, damage received is proportional to temperature. Time no longer matters. At -40 Celsius degree player starts receiving damage. The lower the temperature (usually at night but not necessarily), the higher the damage.

Another useful feature is a [b]list that you can keep on your screen to help you keep track of materials you need for building[/b]. All you need to do is to go to Tablet menu, choose a building from a list of building and click on in with right mouse button. A list will appear to your left which will remain there even after leaving the tablet menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zpIQgvw.gif[/img]

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2]
Alongside all of this, we have made some quality of life improvements – not as spectacular, minor additions and some readjustments, but with everything else, they should improve the gameplay experience. [b]Mouse sensitivity[/b] has been corrected, as well as [b]camera movement[/b] during sleeping animation. [b]Full controller support[/b] has been included in the Main Menu. Moreover, during tutorial missions, you can view the gamepad controls. When choosing your landing location on Mars globe, you can [b]manually rotate[/b] the globe.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Aj6WSEN.gif[/img]

[h2]Some music to soothe the soul[/h2]
We’re working on a certain feature which will allow you to listen to your own music in-game – [b]a radio[/b]! It’s still a work in progress and a subject to change, but here is overview of how it works for now: 

Before launching the game, just add your favourite songs to an appropriate folder. They will all appear in a menu on the Tablet, from where you can arrange them into [b]playlists[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/54552f6b2af68468b2726c0eb536ba0b37300b2e.png[/img]

Once you’re done, all that’s left is to build a radio and place it in your preferred place. Music will play automatically whenever you’re in the radio’s range and if you’d like to stop the music, just click on the radio. You can destroy it and thus move it to your Inventory if you’d like to change its location later. All your playlists are saved, so you can come back to them anytime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/7e92891a0068c2579fbebc4c40ab857fad6fc101.png[/img]

All these improvements are developed alongside [b]fixes for the Beta version[/b]. Even more content is coming as a lot of these new features are work in progress. We have yet to tell you about the rocket launcher, but that’s a story for another devlog as we’re still working on it. :)

[h2]Previous devlogs[/h2]
If you're catching up with development on Occupy Mars: Prologue page, you might notice that devlog #44 and #45 are missing – that's because these 2 devlogs were mostly focused on Beta status. You can see read them here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3360263387975427018
https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3360263388001738354

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #43: Development Progress & Beta Status
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

[h3]We’re back with another devlog![/h3]

As some of you may know, we’ve been busy with another game of ours that has just been released, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864700/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter/][b]Dinosaur Fossil Hunter[/b][/url], but that doesn’t mean development of Occupy Mars: The Game has stopped! Quite the opposite, we have [i]a lot[/i] to talk about, so let’s get on with it!


[h3]Improved game interface[/h3]

Our dev team cooperates with a team of artists to further[b] improve game UI and Tablet interfaces[/b] so it’s both intuitive to navigate and true to Occupy Mars technical spirit. Some of the screens we’re working on are:
[list]
[*] Sleep Panel
[*] Building / Blueprints menu
[*] New Map (Radar)
[*] Quest Panel
[*] Tech Tree Panel
[*] Character Creation Screen
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/a00fb0a45d81f92340c8997f58c7474153ecb794.png[/img]

Sleep Panel in particular went through some big changes and while it can still go through some changes, we’d like to show you its current look! Now you’ll be able to set the time with up/down arrows or use a slider to set the time even more accurately. You’ll no longer have to set time to full hours. Want to take a 30 minute nap? No problem! :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yzWHZ3o.gif[/img]

The map you can access through the tablet menu is now also available in the rover, so during the long journeys, you won’t have to move away from rover controls in order to check your current location! Moreover, the [b]map will allow you to control the electricity flow in your base[/b]. Other than that, you can also remotely activate and deactivate switches to control the flow of other substances, such as water in pump station.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CyFSsVY.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yuwGIiR.gif[/img]

We have also made some changes to the notification system. First of all, you’ll no longer have to read the same message over and over again every time you pick up a potato or routinely perform some other actions. [b]Similar notifications will be grouped together[/b] to avoid spam. We also made some fixes to weather notifications. 


[h3]Graphical improvements[/h3]

Graphics of Occupy Mars: The Game keep getting better day by day! Of course, the most major changes are already past us – you don’t need to worry. :) What we’ve decided to work on further is lightning and postprocessing. Thanks to recent improvements, scenes look much more realistic, which you might have already seen on some of our more recent screenshots. Here is a little comparison:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/e7ad24871872806764194b672680e0552fb8dd2a.png[/img]

To add more life to the game, we also want to make use of [b]motion capture[/b] and include more animations. Our astronaut will have different animations while sleeping, sitting and much more!

Some tweaks were made to the [b]rover lights and player’s flashlight[/b]. We noticed that at their previous state, lights were barely able to provide enough light for the player. Flashlight is now positioned a little bit differently and its light is much more intense, while rover lights should give you a good enough light to see the rover’s closest surroundings.

Weather effects have also been improved to blend in nicely with the current game’s graphics and lighting. New weather effect [b]Solar Storm[/b] has been added which is even more vivid and beautiful with the new lighting system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/965a86147f152e7267099c1124e2a969a53e6c20.png[/img]


[h3]New locations to visit[/h3]

World of Occupy Mars: The Game keeps expanding and there are even more locations to explore! 

Besides lava tubes you already know about, [b]caves[/b] can be found at random places. You’ll be able to find items in some of them and they can also serve as a good hiding spot when weather unexpectedly worsens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/b0cf33a21ce906434837c0c5e18a6555c72228cf.png[/img]

There are also [b]more abandoned bases[/b] scattered throughout Mars. Contrary to the other ones, these will look differently and hide very useful equipment such as parts necessary for building a jetpack or your robot companion Spotty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/bd821d32afc54c6d8312524a2da6770b4b9adc7d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/3518f54ccd173eae1c60d3ebb462c20e2042c361.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/abcd6ceafacb57f4f8e36699449973dd12004603.png[/img]


[h3]New mechanics[/h3]

We are also working on numerous additional mechanics.

You’ll be able to charge up your rover in the hangar with the use of a [b]special plug[/b] in the hangar. 

Speaking of [b]remote contro[/b]l, we have finished implementing mechanics related to antenna and their radio range – if you’re within the antenna's reach, you’ll be able to remotely control various devices.

We’re polishing the [b]radiation mechanic[/b].

Before, if your suit wasn’t charged and you found yourself in the radiation area, radiation level would increase and after passing a certain value, you would receive damage. It would stop only after you hid in a safe place and the radiation level decreased.

Now, this mechanic is closely connected to the aforementioned Solar Storm. If you enter the radiation area, you receive damage at once, and it will only cease after leaving the affected area. There are also specific areas where you can expect a high radiation level – for example, areas with [b]uranium rocks[/b] nearby.

As for a brand new mechanic, there will also be a helpful system which will [b]highlight the interactable objects[/b] in the area.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zrlziHb.gif[/img]

Our team is now working on a [b]rocket launcher mechanic[/b], which will allow you to shoot down meteors endangering you and your hub. This is a work in progress and we hope to tell you more about it in the future, as well as about many other things we have in store. :)


[h2]Beta playtests status[/h2]

As the end note, we’d like to tell you about the [b]status of the Beta[/b] and hopefully clear up some confusion that has arisen recently. 

So far only small numbers of people got access to the beta since we wanted to iron-out some issues and also finish the above-mentioned content updates before we let more people in. The people who played so far also had an NDA to avoid spoiling the unfinished parts :) 

Now the time has come and in the next few days [b]we are going to let a few thousand more people in[/b]. This is an important milestone in preparation for the Early Access Release. To keep track of all your feedback we have also created a separate Sub-Forum on Steam called [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/758690/discussions/3/]Beta Discussions[/url] where it will be easier to keep track of the beta related issues. Please also remember to [url=https://forms.gle/GhnUszERMjpDDrNy5]fill our survey[/url] after playing the Beta. 

Stay tuned for future announcements and devlogs!

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Devlog #41: Tech Tree & New Finds
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

First of all, our apologies for not publishing anything in December. With Christmas, New Year’s Eve and all the accompanying preparations, things have been busy for our team in work and outside of it. As a result, it was difficult to fit in a devlog during that time. We’ll make sure to let you know about any such delays in the future.

We need more time to wrap up our preparations for upcoming Beta. As much as we initially wanted to make this devlog an announcement for beta tests, we don’t want to make the delay any longer. Today, we’d like to tell you about our progress on the game. As soon as we have everything ready, we’ll make a separate announcement regarding the Beta.

[h3]What have we been working on during these past 2 months?[/h3]

Our main focus has been shaping up the Tech Tree. You may recall this tab being present on the tablet in the Prologue, but being otherwise inaccessible.

We’re been intensively working on it – both on its functionality and aesthetics. At first, Technologies were unlocked by fulfilling certain conditions such as building 10 objects of a specific type. 

Now, unlocking a Technology will require a specific amount of points, which are acquired for gaining experience. You will gain experience corresponding with every field of the Tech Tree (Botany, Electricity etc.) depending on your actions. For example, planting seeds will allow you to raise Botany experience, while mining will improve your experience in Materials field. 

Additionally, we want to include a laboratory desks, which will allow you to develop more advanced Technologies and examine your finds from abandoned bases. We’re also working on a new visual design of the menu, which will be much clearer and adjusted to the new experience system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/ba2666181d59f35cbbee690a160c82bf158c4cc7.png[/img]

Speaking of abandoned bases, our team has added a loot system to make sure that exploring abandoned bases gives you enough finds to make those trips worth it. 

Before you start stripping down the base, it’s a good idea to search it first, as you can find many useful items left behind by your predecessors, such as packages with food, seed magazines or upgrades for your vehicles. Sometimes, you can even find items that are only available at a later stage of the game!

Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity and Perseverance have been added and they can all be found during your adventure! Pickup Truck has been implemented in the game and can now drive through Martian landscapes! There is also another Easter Egg, but we’d like you to discover it yourself in the game. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/41feceb03db6d5a81a47691ea4a1ab1f37d30e10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/1e42c9a47dab316fcf23a5044b8b2d7dc8576d80.png[/img]

We are also redesigning some of the other menu panels in the player's tablet as well, for example the new build screen looks much better🙂

There are also some other improvements leaning more on a technical side of things.

In one of our previous devlog we mentioned that some of our team members were in charge of reworking the translations system. Sure, some translations have been present in the Prologue, but there is quite a lot of new content to translate. 😉

We have also improved loading time to make sure you can swiftly boot up the game and start your adventure. We are also implementing new achievements in the game, in total there will be close to 50 of them!

Thank you for taking the time to read this devlog and we hope you like what’s in store for you. We're also working on a more detailed roadmap to present to you in future devlogs. As always, we invite you to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sv9UWeh]Discord[/url] server if you’d like to hang out with fellow Occupy Mars enthusiasts.

Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Occupy Mars The Game Devlog #40: Vehicles, drones and more improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Martians![/h2]

To all of you who have been frequently checking out Occupy Mars: The Game’s development progress – thank you. It’s time for another update – number 40!

Let’s dive in! We have made a thorough interview with Occupy Mars development team to gather all the juicy details regarding our development progress – both huge achievements and small things! So what has been going on for the last month?

Let’s start with a [b]Pickup Truck[/b], which one of our dev team members introduced to you in the last devlog! Model has been completed and we can now show the truck in its full glory alongside other vehicles! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/1e9c7dae4b86aa3140629025a2f625afe7e85a32.png[/img]

As you can see, Early Access version will include [b]5 unique vehicles[/b] providing you with a different traveling experience! From left to right, there is a [b]Heavy Rover[/b] you all know and (hopefully) love, [b]ATV (quad)[/b], [b]motorcycle[/b], [b]Pickup Truck[/b] and [b]automatic Drone Rover[/b], which you can see below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/e92dbb694f9ddaab61db5c34214e0774d296de3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/9560cfbd77247363ea2029fd1ed721eeebc43046.png[/img]

Which one are you looking forward to the most? 🤩

Other than 3D models, the team has been making adjustments related to various in game mechanics. That includes working on physics, improving vehicle controlling mechanics and also modifying ground’s properties, so different types of ground would affect speed and fluidity of vehicles’ movements. That also required input from our sound designer as he had to prepare sounds that would reflect the types of ground vehicles would move on.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EZXmkGM.gif[/img]

A different team member had wrapped up their work on the [b]flying drone and remote controller[/b] and moved onto [b]improving translations system[/b]. Thanks to that, applying translations will be much quicker and more effective. Work on an electricity system is being wrapped up as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vWpJe59.gif[/img]

Another one of our members has been continuously working on [b]Spotty[/b]. Our best robotic buddy required the same amounts of attention. After thorough testing, we have added sounds, reworked his animations and included gearbox system, which allows Spotty to traverse through Mars’ landscapes, at different speed and with different movements, depending on the ground type.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xFPywZw.gif[/img]

To make you feel at home in Occupy Mars, we have included a neat and quite simple feature. [b]Depending on a costume colour[/b] chosen by the player during character creation, [b]the same colour can now be applied to every building that this player builds[/b]! It adds a layer of personalisation that – we hope – may be appreciated. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/05095cb1f7bfdd0e3ae7b9a54fcc110524c31376.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/465244320b2867ef6b63eac2f2efed6cfacab080.png[/img]

Another improvement has been made to the [b]Terrain system[/b]. Before, it was only possible to destroy certain rocks in the area. This mechanic is being expanded to include more types of rocks. With the system’s graphics overhaul and this change, we hope that the terrain will feel much more natural and that rocks will nicely blend in the Mars’ landscape. 

The last mechanic we’d like to mention is the brand new [b]recycling mechanic[/b]. With this mechanic, you’ll be able to destroy – for example – unneeded Steel Plates and retrieve materials that were used to create them – with a little loss. For the sake of convenience, you will also be able to recycle big amounts of resources at once by gathering them all in the Heavy Rover’s container and then pouring them all into the shredder, which will handle the rest. 

More complex changes were made to the [b]Freeplay’s beginning phase[/b] of the game, in order to serve as a more intuitive and interesting introduction to Occupy Mars. Certain objects have been moved and new missions have been added.

Do you recall the [b]spaceship[/b] that made its debut back in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/758690/announcements/detail/3006697206878825989]Devlog #36[/url]? 😉 This is how it looks like now – feeling old yet?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/025030b1afbaa7eaf060d22994a39e7b852d5b2e.png[/img]

Jokes aside, this is real scenery that awaits you in the game, but you will get to see this rocket in a better state as well!

Lastly, one of our dev team members is working on the [b]game’s compatibility with distribution platforms[/b] as Occupy Mars: The Game will be available not only on Steam. They are also working on integrating the [b]RichPresence[/b] Discord feature with Occupy Mars: The Game.

That concludes last month’s progress on the game. As you can see, most of these features are approaching their finish lines, bringing overall Early Access development closer to the finish line as well. 

Before that, we promised you some news regarding Beta and we will deliver – just give us some more time to wrap up what we need. We hope to share more with you then. 😀

One thing we’d like to emphasize, as we have noticed that one of our messages calling the game “completely different” from the Prologue caused some confusion on Steam forums – [b]Occupy Mars: The Game, despite being a major leap from the Prologue in terms of graphics, optimization, content and mechanics improvements, doesn’t stray from the premise of the Prologue.[/b] It shares its gameplay basics with the Prologue and is very much the same game, just in vastly improved form with additional content.

Here is a little comparison between Prologue and upcoming Early Access version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/05037506ef830d7169abd9dd129ba463c47a7e44.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/d8a3464bff9db28da7d66ad58dd4b9e6434bb5e6.png[/img]

With that little side note, this devlog comes to a close, but you can expect something special in the next few weeks.

Also, if you have any questions about Occupy Mars: The Game or any of our games – be it released or upcoming ones – make sure to leave them for us during the [b]AMA (Ask Me Anything) event[/b] that will take place today, on [b]November 19 at 3 PM CEST (2 PM CET)[/b]. At this time, we’ll open a special Reddit thread dedicated to the event and we’ll be waiting for your questions! Once the AMA starts, we’ll provide you with a link in the comments section of this devlog's discussion thread – stay tuned!

notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Martians![/h2]

Time to let you in on our recent development progress. 

For the past few weeks, we have been focusing on two certain areas of the game – the Electricity System and Terrain System. We have been polishing these systems in order to further improve them, make them more practical and realistic.

In the case of the [b]Terrain System[/b], we have been trying out various techniques, which would allow generating marks on the ground corresponding to the player’s actions. It’s especially important on Mars’ sandy ground, which is not as sturdy as some other areas and should change under the weight of various objects. You can see our current results below:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vzkNqoa.gif][/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ezv8imc.gif[/img]

Regarding the [b]Electricity System[/b] – some of you have suggested implementing a system that would allow you to temporarily cut off certain sections of the base from power if needed. 
We think this is a great suggestion, which is why we’re currently reworking the system! Now bases will be divided into sections with [b]circuit breakers[/b], which will control the flow of current. Each input socket will also have a breaker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/18b282330db953cb60570643b380e8b8acbb445e.png[/img]

We are also adding a [b]“smart meters” feature[/b], which will allow you to remotely control circuit breakers and enable or disable specific breakers remotely, provided the player is within range of built antennas. That said, circuit breakers are not the only objects that you’ll be able to control remotely! As long as you’re in the antenna’s range, you can also control other devices, including outdoor Batteries and Power Splitter. HQ building can enlarge the antenna’s range thanks to its own antenna built in the building.

Remember the drone we mentioned in the last devlog? You’ll be able to use the same handheld remote to control the drone and heavy rover as well!

This devlog might be shorter than previous ones, but rest assured that Occupy Mars will have a lot to offer! In fact, we have prepared a [b]summary of the game’s evolution throughout its various iterations[/b]. You can also take a look at what we’re planning for the upcoming Beta version and for the future updates. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/c2eb6ef3cf23913f2d9179063ca623ecb15edca1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Occupy Mars: The Game Development Progress
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Martians![/h3]

It's time for another devlog regarding development of Occupy Mars: The Game! We have decided to publish it on Occupy Mars: Prologue page as well – to make sure you don't miss it. 🙂 Just a heads-up – it's best to follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/758690/Occupy_Mars_The_Game/]Occupy Mars: The Game Steam page[/url], as all the future and past development updates are sure to be there!

Some of you have been worrying about development slowing down. We’re here to let you know that it’s absolutely not true! 

Just as this devlog is being created, our Occupy Mars dev team is working hard on [b]various aspects of the game[/b]. 💪 As such, it’s difficult to dedicate this devlog to one certain milestone. Instead, we have decided to give you a detailed overview of what our team members have been up to during this time.

Let’s start with necessities: our Sound Designer has been filling in the gaps of our [b]sound design[/b]. Sounds of walking and various other sounds that had been missing from the game are now being steadily added or improved. Sound plays a major role in Occupy Mars, as it not only contributes to Mars’ desolate atmosphere, but also serves as an important feedback to player whenever he’s interacting with the game world. There is also another new feature in the works which has a huge impact on immersion (pictured below), we’ll be able to tell more about it in the future devlogs. 🤞

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/273636753407c7ab2520bb6be68886a56640c5e7.jpg[/img]

Another one of our team members has been working on the [b]ground detection system[/b] – it’s a task closely related to sound design and makes it possible for the game system to recognize different types of ground and associate it with a specific sound. In other words, with this detection enabled, you’ll be able to hear different sounds while running on sturdy rocky ground or your base’s metallic floor.

Animations have been improved. Various new ones have been added, while existing ones have been polished. We have also managed to fix many bugs on our way. One of the most notable ones would be the kneeling issue. Basically, it was easy for player to get stuck when trying to stand up in a place where standing up shouldn’t be possible. Animation speed and transitions between crouching and standing state have been improved and an [b]obstacle detection system[/b] has been added to make sure the character won’t struggle while traversing through these tiny [b]lava tunnels[/b]. 😉 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/82118e6b578daa38b126ebcf9ce890fa562e5b01.png[/img]

Another very helpful, albeit difficult to illustrate addition to the game is a pathfinding system [b]based on machine learning[/b]. Basically we teach the artificial neural network how to navigate the martian landscape, which then navigates it like a car or a robot would in real life. We decided to take this step due to the long time it takes to generate standard pathfinding solutions on the procedurally generated terrain. In particular, it’s useful when it comes to this little buddy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/7ab32422fd5f0b4cc7b3dbf81f127b59445b9739.png[/img]

Do you remember this little fellow? 🙂 We’ve been working hard to make him a reliable company during your adventure on Mars. Many new commands are currently being included to make Spotty as responsive as possible.

Our team members have also been working on expanding the game’s world. New locations have been added. Other than well known rocky landscapes, you’ll be able to explore places filled with snow and ice. There will be various deserted bases scattered across the Red Planet. You will be able to explore them, see remains of what used to be home to astronauts before you and tear those remains apart in other to gather more resources. Even if their mission has ended, they can be a great help to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/868039fd1a5a47dd579cf35f73e87dc625f5b9fd.png[/img]

With so many places to explore, will you be able to see it all? It depends on you, but we’re making sure to provide you with all the tools you may need! Another team member is currently working on a [b]flying version of Ingenuity helicopter[/b], which will allow you to peek into places that would normally appear inaccessible. Make sure to charge him first, otherwise he won’t fly far. 😉 Drone’s batteries are charged with solar energy when on standby and can additionally be charged by the player. 

The Rover Controller you may know from the Prologue will become a general use Remote Controler for many different vehicles - such us the helicopter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/6d6d9608171039b646e0a9d3dace482583567b83.png[/img]

Speaking of vehicles, our team has also been working on heavy rover’s driving system to make it more intuitive and enjoyable.

And now last, but definitely not least, we’d like to show you a [b]new vehicle[/b] that’s being worked on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/05ac0f94d992472ade6e0345f5137309096d1780.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/4e1c250c2af9a98c42561b0ddf65f97a39a2e75f.png[/img]

Here is a message from our team member who is in charge of this new amazing vehicle and who wanted to tell you a bit about it himself. 😊

[i]Hey, guys! Recently, I've been working on a new vehicle, which – I hope – will close the gap between Heavy Rover and light ATV Quad. At first glance it seems like it’s just Offroad Cybertruck, but don't be fooled! Because this is MarsTruck, an offroad pickup and i have no clue why you would call it otherwise 
( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°). Okay, I guess You might guess what served as an inspiration for bodywork ;). It's offroad pickup with AWD and a small amount of regolith carrying ability. It has 2-3 seats and a place for Spotty companion. It also has enough space for inventory or an additional battery extender in the frunk. Offroad suspension (double wishbone at front, and independent on rear) and big wheels will get you to places that are hard to reach on foot or with other vehicles. I hope you’ll have as much fun riding it as I have creating it right now![/i]

That would be it! This devlog turned out to be surprisingly lengthy, but we hope that gave you a good idea regarding our progress on the game. Occupy Mars is a big project and one that will definitely take us a while longer, but it gives us a lot of joy and we can’t wait to show you the end results. 

Please bear with us a bit longer and if you have any suggestions for us regarding the game itself or anything else, do let us know on our Discord server, Steam forums or anywhere else! Every new game is a new learning opportunity for us and we’d like to do what we can to make this waiting time more manageable.

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/35f3c8844b7467ba0c3c27543a794730e7ef41c6.png[/img][/url]

Add the game to your Wishlist to make sure you don’t miss any news regarding Occupy Mars!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/758690/Occupy_Mars_The_Game/

Thank you for all your support so far! 

Best Regards,
Occupy Mars Team

[h1]Dear Martians![/h1] 

Last week we've launched a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1310520/view/2932364983752777253]Big Update[/url] with many changes including new crane controls. Today we are launching fifth update with some bugfixes and "quality of life" improvements. You can read about the previous patches in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1310520/discussions/0/2916598577618730650/]full changelog here[/url]. Read more below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/9006c5dfb499eaba70da29a4ec588beb2742a434.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog v0.44.5[/h2]
[list]
[*] improved Rover driving physics
[*] adjusted Rover center of mass for better handling
[*] adjusted Player's seat position inside Rover for better visibility
[*] fixed bug which required pressing hotbar key 2x to deploy cable
[*] fixed unloading the tipper on the shredder when Rover has low battery
[*] fixed the possibility of pulling out trailers from the shredder storage
[*] fixed Rover collider which caused jumping on rocks (clang bug)
[*] fixed Rover remote controller camera bug and range bug
[*] fixed "Repair" button on the workbench while fixing Rover board 
[*] crane camera postprocess is no longer black & white
[*] fixed issue with mouse sensitivity on low FPS
[*] enabled the possibility to set mouse sensitivity even lower than before
[*] fixed UI on the shredder panel
[*] performance improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37933792/86b57b8cbb9ad01362069662917b70c19756a9d7.png[/img]

Remember that while playing you can [b]Press F4[/b] to send feedback to us. Thanks to your invaluable feedback we will keep updating the game to prepare the best possible Early Access launch of the full game.


Play Prologue and have fun! 
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Second Patch! v0.44.2
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians![/h1] 

Thank you very much for all the feedback. Today we are back with a new update! This patch contains as many changes as we were able to add & test during the last 3 days — all of them are based on your feedback from forums and reviews. 

[h2]Changelog v0.44.2[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the possibility to drink water from the sink
[*] Added the possibility to consume food using hotkeys 1-6
[*] Added information when rock is small enough to grab
[*] Added new tool: small plant crate in the Hab for replanting
[*] Added visible outlines to CO2 Scrubber valves
[*] Balance: lowered hunger and water consumption
[*] Improved controls and camera on the PCB Workbench
[*] Reduced cable pickup time & rock drilling time 
[*] Fixed issue with rover doors giving too much damage
[*] Limited time for rag-doll animation
[*] Reworked mouse sensitivity
[*] Various text improvements
[*] Fixed issue with changing Rover trailer on the crusher
[*] Fixed issue with power in the Hab after load
[*] Crusher has power from the beginning
[*] Improved usage of tools
[*] Improved lighting & contrast
[*] Improved rock mining
[*] Improved Rover driving & handling
[*] Fixed issue with muting sound
[*] Fixed issue with small solar panel colliders
[*] Improved energy calculation in buildings
[*] Shorter sandstorm!
[/list]
You can find the previous [b]changelogs[/b] in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1310520/discussions/0/2916598577618730650/]this forum thread[/url].

[b]Keep in mind:[/b]
[olist]
[*] you need to start new game in order to find new tools & features (old saves won't have them)
[*] the Plant Crate is a "prototype" tool / mechanic - we are open for your feedback regarding it
[*] if you played using custom key bindings you will have to re-bind your controls after updating to this version. It's a small cost for improving the workbench controls. We hope you don't mind.
[/olist]
[h2]The Plan[/h2]

Coming soon — our main focus for the next updates is:
[list]
[*] Improved tutorials with new tutorial location
[*] Crane controls
[*] Translations
[/list]

Remember that while playing you can [b]Press F4[/b] to send feedback to us. Thanks to your invaluable feedback we will keep updating the game to prepare the best possible Early Access launch of the full game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QspTxsN.gif[/img]

Play Prologue and have fun! 
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Occupy Mars: Prologue Launch!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians! [/h1] 

[h3]Are you ready for your mission to Mars? Our free prologue version of Occupy Mars is NOW available on Steam! 🚀[/h3]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/d7538e29ef372ab803ac168ed629656d2e7579c3.png[/img]

[h2]Live Stream![/h2]

What's more, we are streaming live now, so make sure to join us! 

[olist] [*] [b]Steam:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1310520/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1310520/[/url]
[*] [b]Twitch:[/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games] https://www.twitch.tv/pyramid_games[/url]
[*] [b]YouTube:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/PyramidlabPl/]https://www.youtube.com/c/PyramidlabPl/[/url] [/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1310520/Occupy_Mars_Prologue/

[h3]Survive the Prologue and help us prepare for the full Early Access release![/h3]

After the Demo version presented during the Steam Games Festival we've prepared a [url=https://forms.gle/nDnGpyhWQ6mHvqaRA]survey[/url] for you. Below you can find the answers from that survey. We've tried our best to implement as many of Your requests as possible in the Prologue. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/6a6ccab0a9689feb190f445450bef0279e8cb2af.png[/img]

We've also asked you about features most expected in the Prologue version. After reading your answers -we've managed to add most of those requested (and more - you can find [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1310520/view/2765725453305431112]the changelog here[/url]) (except [i]translations[/i]) which are almost done but will be added in the next updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/8f966a0f709f572663d011c61432ebc1ba75b459.png[/img]

[b]You can now play with saves, change key bindings, automatically load rocks on trailer, invert mouse, fix PCB and survive many shorter sandstorms! [/b]

While playing the Prologue remember to [b]Press F4[/b] during the game to send feedback to us. Thanks to your invaluable feedback we will keep updating the game to prepare the best possible Early Access launch of the full game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QspTxsN.gif[/img]

Play Prologue and have fun! 
Occupy Mars Team

notes.title: Prologue Progress
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Martians! [/h1]

[b]The Prologue is in the final stages of testing before the release.[/b] Thanks to your amazing feedback and suggestions, we've added lots of improvements that require additional tests and fixes. Due to this, we have to postpone the release date of the prologue slightly. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1310520/Occupy_Mars_Prologue/]The prologue[/url] will be released in August.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31460179/95d8cf944ab53f440f59ba47f65983abac818f39.png[/img]

[b]New features added since the Steam Festival Demo version:[/b]
[list] [*]new semi-automated grabber & simplified rocks loading mechanic for Heavy Rover
[*] possibility to change key bindings
[*] possibility to plug in oxygen to the Rover / buildings
[*] enabled save system
[*] possibility to produce water bottles from the well
[*] enabled well expansion
[*] implemented workbench for fixing PCBs
[*] new missions after the storm
[*] new night sky
[*] new interface including HUD
[*] new item icons
[*] improved rocks physics
[*] dust storm ends quicker
[*] new printing animation
[*] new animation of unloading rocks 
[*] prologue intro cinematic
[*] new animated tutorials
[*] player’s AI sounds in the spacesuit
[*] hundreds of bugfixes and optimizations
[*] and much more! [/list]

All those changes were implemented thanks to your feedback and they bring us much closer to the release of the full game in Early Access later this year. 

[b]Meanwhile take a look at our new prologue teaser:[/b]

[previewyoutube=2zTwti9onhI;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned!
Occupy Mars Team
